text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian defeats the "Emperor" and 
claims victory in the "Japan Cup". It was 
the moment a brand-new legend was born—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching from the stands, Mayano Top Gun 
felt her heart race at that incredible 
run, wishing more than ever to challenge 
Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after reaching the summit, Narita 
Brian insatiably seeks the next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though many hail her as the successor to 
the "Emperor," she simply walks her own 
path. Next up is the final leg of the 
Autumn Senior Triple Crown: the Arima 
Kinen!
